proposed.sourceName: MUI (Indonesian Ulema Council) — Fatwa No. 10 of 2018 on Food & Beverage Products Containing Alcohol/Ethanol
proposed.paraphrase: MUI's fatwa permits ethanol as a solvent/carrier in flavors and seasonings provided it is NOT derived from the khamr (alcoholic-beverage) industry — synthetic or non-khamr fermentation ethanol is allowed — with the final beverage product tolerated below 0.5%; khamr-derived ethanol is impermissible and unclean.

proposed.sourceName: MUIS (Islamic Religious Council of Singapore) — Fatwa on Ethanol in Food Flavorings
proposed.paraphrase: MUIS rules that ethanol (natural or synthetic) used as a solvent in food flavorings is allowed when not produced from prohibited products, with ethanol in the flavoring not exceeding 0.5% and in the final product not exceeding 0.1%, used exclusively for flavoring.

researcherNote: Flavor ethanol carrier at the general position. Major halal authorities (MUI, MUIS) permit non-khamr ethanol carriers below threshold, and industrial flavor ethanol is generally non-khamr, so the general position widely accepts it -> seeded draft grade 2 (Questionable - widely accepted). Two independent tier-1 halal authorities. High-traffic -> two independent sources present. APPROVED by owner 2026-06-29.
